component.name: Detect It Easy (cdie)
component.summary: Identify compilers, packers, protectors and file types

description.p: This is cdie, the C port of Detect It Easy. It runs the Detect It Easy signature database to identify the file type, compiler, linker, packer, protector and installer of PE, ELF, Mach-O, DEX, APK and other files.

Besides the scan result it shows file information, entropy, hashes, strings, imports, exports, resources, symbols, the memory map, a hex view and a disassembler. The command-line scanner diec prints the same results, and die-update keeps the signature database current.
